title: Grilled Barramundi Skewers with Tropical Slaw
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish featuring grilled barramundi skewers served with a tangy tropical slaw.

ingredients.name: Nourishing oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or avocado oil

ingredients.name: Silky soy sauce
ingredients.notes: such as tamari or coconut aminos

ingredients.name: Brazilian spice blend
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, and chili powder

instructions: Thread the barramundi fillets onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the nourishing oil, silky soy sauce, and Brazilian spice blend.
Brush the mixture onto the barramundi skewers, making sure they're evenly coated.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the fish is cooked through.
While the skewers are grilling, prepare the tropical slaw by combining shredded cabbage, diced mango, and chopped cilantro in a bowl.
Squeeze the lime juice over the slaw and toss to combine.
Once the skewers are done, remove them from the grill and serve with the tropical slaw.
Garnish with lime zest and serve immediately.
